meta.name: Young Sherlock
meta.description: Sherlock Holmes is a disgraced young man, raw and unfiltered, when he finds himself wrapped up in a murder case that threatens his liberty. His first ever case unravels a globe-trotting conspiracy that changes his life forever.

videos.title: The Case of the Missing Scrolls
videos.overview: 1871. A wayward young Sherlock Holmes is sent to Oxford to keep out of trouble, but he soon finds himself the prime suspect in a police investigation that threatens his entire future.

videos.title: The Case of the Burnt Photograph
videos.overview: Sherlock is thrown into jail. He has to clear his name or face the gallows.

videos.title: The Case of the Unarmed Man
videos.overview: The game's afoot. With another murder and two professors missing, it's a race against time for Sherlock and Moriarty to find them before the killer does.

videos.title: The Case of the Missing Button
videos.overview: Sherlock returns to his childhood home in search of answers.

videos.title: The Case of Young Sherlock Holmes
videos.overview: Years after a tragic accident that tore the Holmes family apart, Moriarty and Sherlock come to blows as they investigate that fateful day.

videos.title: The Case of the Killing Jar
videos.overview: As Sherlock digs deeper into the Oxford murders, he discovers a shocking connection.

videos.title: The Case of the Two Corners
videos.overview: An impossible ultimatum challenges Sherlock's loyalties.

videos.title: The Case of Beatrice Holmes
videos.overview: Family ties and friendships are tested in the Holmes family reunion from hell.
